rawText: EL ENEMIGO CABERNET FRANC 2019 Mendoza · Argentina
description: El Enemigo is a project by winemaker Alejandro Vigil in Mendoza, known for expressive single-variety and blended wines sourced from high-altitude vineyards in the Uco Valley. Cabernet Franc from this region benefits from significant diurnal temperature variation, which helps retain acidity and aromatic freshness. The wine typically undergoes aging in French oak barrels for a period of months to a year, contributing structure and complexity.
